messages:
mika: quick note 1 proposing a compact policy header `X-RW-PolicyV` (tiny kv format) that SDKs can emit to improve quota bucketing across dedicated+fallback pools. plan: telemetry -> opt-in helper -> console dry-run -> warn -> flip. thoughts?
taylor: compact sounds good. main constraint is header size and proxies that trim long headers. keep it <512 bytes.
ishaan: SDK impact: py/ts/go will get a helper `routing.setPolicyV({...})` and a sync `routing.flushPolicy()` for CLIs/lambdas. prefer non-breaking helpers over changing defaults.
rachel: Console needs a "Preview enforcement" action that runs a historical replay and shows per-tenant token delta. also show confidence band and a note if header was likely scraped by gateways.
mika: telemetry-first: emit `policy.signal` events with fields: tenant_id, sdk_lang, policy_present, policy_version, estimated_tokens, resolved_route, sdk_version. sample low by default, raise in canary. no PII.
taylor: py gotcha: background handshakes are lost in short processes. example safe shim for testing: ```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(policy_mode='eager')
c.routing.set_policy({'priority':'gold'})
c.routing.flush_policy()  # blocks until header sent
```
ishaan: go SDK will honor env `RW_POLICY_MODE` for infra-only toggles. precedence: explicit API > env var > legacy implicit. will add tests for precedence.
sentry-bot: deploy scheduled: policy-decoder v2 accept compact token on 2025-01-14T02:00Z (job 20021).
ops-bot: canary deploy success 1 policy-decoder v2 on canary-a, traffic 5%. :white_check_mark: 
rachel: rollout guardrail: if any tenant's billed vs predicted tokens delta >6% sustained for 48h post-flip, auto-disable policy enforcement for that tenant and page SRE. need automation.
mika: action items: 1) ishaan open SDK helper PRs + flush API, 2) taylor add py shim + unit test, 3) rachel spec Console preview + replay endpoint, 4) infra/SRE author rollback automation. i'll draft RFC and timeline.
taylor: I'll start the py/ts PRs today and include a tiny lint for quickstart to surface old implicit patterns.
ishaan: will add tests to ensure batcher keys include tenant_id so we never mix tenant policies into the same batch.
mika: thanks all  will post RFC link when ready and schedule sync.
